caption: The drawing is a technical illustration rendered in fine pencil lines on a vertically oriented, off-white or yellowed paper. It depicts three main views of a small table: a top view, a side sectional view, and a profile view. The top view, positioned near the upper center, shows an elliptical tabletop supported by three radiating supports that converge at a central circular hub. The sectional view is directly beneath the top view and displays the structure and dimensions beneath the tabletop, including one of the supports and a central cylinder. The profile view, occupying the lower portion of the sheet, presents the table’s side: an elliptical tabletop, a turned (ornamentally shaped) central column or post, and three outward-curving legs attached at the base of the post. Dimension lines and numbers indicating measurements in inches are distributed throughout the drawing. The drawing includes smudges or reddish-brown stains on the left side and slight age marks. The artist’s name “Hans Westendorff” is printed near the bottom left corner. The drawing uses only shades of grey (graphite pencil) and provides no shading or color beyond the linework and background.
title: Table
